test_channel_close_immediately: test that closing a gRPC channel immediately after call invocation returns CANCELLED status code
test_channel_close_while_active: test that closing a gRPC channel while a streaming call is active cancels the call
test_context_manager_channel_close: test that exiting a gRPC channel context manager cancels active streaming calls
test_concurrent_channel_closes: test that many concurrent channel close calls do not cause deadlocks or crashes
test_callback_exception_no_deadlock: test that raising an exception in a future done callback does not cause a deadlock
